summary: Iteration 32: Suggest Suppliers/Activities (pending + admin approve/reject), Activity Event Poll (activity-vote, lock, date_tbd), Referral Map not-configured state. Backend 19/19 new tests pass after fixing a CRITICAL 500 in PATCH /api/events/{id} (KeyError 'date_tbd'), which broke the edit-date flow and every edit that sent a date (the frontend always sends one). Regression suites iter30/iter31 pass 44/44 after updating stale expectations (Suppliers/Activities are now suggestable). Frontend (375x667, employee + admin) fully verified: Suggest header button + 'Suggest an activity' title, Start a team vote -> tick 2 -> 'Create vote (2)' -> sheet (default 'Next team activity', past-date and bad-format toasts) -> /event/{id} showing 'Date to be confirmed (pencilled in for 11 Nov 2026)' + 'Vote on the activity' with locations; Lock in sets title + location; editing the date clears TBD; Referral Partners List/Map chips show iframe with 'The map isn't set up yet...' message; admin inline Approve/Reject; rating+review regression OK; exactly one share to #Allied Health (message deleted).

critical.issue: FIXED BY T1: 500 KeyError 'date_tbd' in labels[k]. upd always set date_tbd=False when a date was sent, so 'date_tbd' ended up in `changed` for EVERY event (ev.get('date_tbd') None != False), and every edit from event-new.tsx (which always sends date) returned 500. The DB update had already run, but the client got an error and change notifications weren't sent. Fix: leave date_tbd out of `changed`, still save when only date_tbd is cleared (confirming), and fall back to the 'date confirmed' label.

minor.issue: Any edit of a date_tbd event, even just changing the time or name, clears date_tbd because event-new.tsx always sends the date. Consider only confirming when the date actually changes, or adding an explicit 'Confirm date' action.
Description 'Vote for what we do next: A, B.' stays on the event after the activity is locked in (stale text).
2 old Places tests fail (403 vs 400, missing 'link' key). They look stale after Places changed in iteration 30. Not part of this round, so not changed.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY T1: star rating row showed on pending suggestions (tapping opened the review sheet, then the backend returned 400). Now hidden when status === 'pending' (line 283).
'Make it a team event' action still shows on pending activities.

issues: Reject on a pending suggestion opens 'Remove X? This removes the entry and its files for everyone.' Wording should say 'Reject suggestion'.
After editing the event, the header has no back arrow (screen was replaced).

action_items: Review T1's fix in routes/events.py edit_event (date_tbd excluded from changed labels; 'confirming' path).
Hide 'Make it a team event' on pending activities.
Decide whether non-date edits should keep date_tbd (event-new.tsx always sends date).
Optionally update the activity-vote description after lock-in and reword the Reject confirm sheet.
Update/remove the stale iter26 Places tests.
critical_code_review_comments: referral-map.tsx passes the session token in the iframe/WebView query string, so it can leak into server logs and history. Acceptable for an internal app, but a short-lived map token would be safer.
react-native-webview 14.0.1 is imported on web but only rendered natively. Fine.
activity_vote correctly excludes pending activities (404) and de-dupes ids (2 same ids -> 400).

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 new, 44/44 with iter30/31) after fix; 89% before fix

seed_data_creation: TEST_ activities, suppliers and referral partners plus activity-vote events were created and all cleaned up (directory TEST_ = 0, Allied Health TEST_ messages = 0, notifications since the run = 0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. seed_iter32_ui.py seeds 3 approved TEST_UI activities (dir_TEST_ui32_0..2); 'clean <iso_since>' removes them. Server clock is around 2026-10-28. No Google Maps key, so the map shows the not-set-up message.
rca_of_issue: edit_event computed changed = [k for k in upd if ev.get(k) != v], and the new upd['date_tbd']=False was always different from the missing/None value on normal events. labels has no 'date_tbd' key, so the code raised KeyError after the DB write and the endpoint returned 500. Reproduced with PATCH {date} on an activity-vote event; fixed and re-verified via API and the UI edit flow.
